observations.content: Overfitting occurs when a model memorizes training noise and performs poorly on unseen examples [1].

To overcome overfitting, the following techniques can be used:

1. Cross-validation (estimates generalization using held-out folds) [2]
2. Regularization (reduces overfitting by penalizing large weights, such as L2 regularization which adds a squared-weight penalty to the training loss) [3]
3. Early stopping (ends training when validation loss rises) [3]

Based on Chapter 5, the techniques explained are regularization (which reduces overfitting by penalizing large weights, such as L2 regularization which adds a squared-weight penalty to the training loss) and early stopping (which ends training when validation loss rises) [1].
